name: Charge Type 12 Code
definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

BEND.name: Back End Load
BEND.definition: Sales charge paid by the investor when redeeming an investment such as an investment fund.

DISC.name: Discount
DISC.definition: Charge that has been reduced from the standard initial charge levied by a fund, eg, during a launch period or as negotiated by a funds supermarket / discount broker.

FEND.name: Front End Load
FEND.definition: Sales charge paid immediately by the investor when subscribing to an investment such as an investment fund.

REGF.name: Regulatory Fee
REGF.definition: Fee charged by a regulatory authority, eg, Securities and Exchange fees.

SHIP.name: Shipping Charge
SHIP.definition: Charge for shipping, including the insurance of securities.

SPCN.name: Special Concessions
SPCN.definition: Charges, drawdown, or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.

TRAN.name: Transfer Fee
TRAN.definition: In investment funds, a fee charged for the transfer of ownership of an investment fund.
